glosses: cloud (a visible mass of water droplets suspended in the air)
cloud, made of steam, ash, smoke or anything that resembles such a mass (may also be Schwaden or Schwade in this sense)
nebula, enormous masses of interstellar dust and hydrogen in outerspace (may also be Nebel in this sense)

examples.text: Der Mond ist hinter den Wolken.
examples.en: The moon is behind the clouds.

examples.text: Es ist keine Wolke am Himmel.
examples.en: There isn't a cloud in the sky.

examples.text: Ich will über den Wolken fliegen.
examples.en: I want to fly above the clouds.

examples.text: Schau mal auf die Wolke dort drüben.
examples.en: Look at the cloud over there.
